name: PEC Solar Company
old_description: Nestled in the rural and wooded landscapes of Wisconsin, PEC Solar provides custom PV Solar design and installation to residential homes. We’re here to help you lower the energy costs to power your home and help the environment at the same time. Why pay for power from the utility company when you can make it yourself?
about:
PEC Solar Company is a locally owned solar installation firm based near Rio, Wisconsin, in the state's rural, wooded region. The business was established by a professional engineer who holds licenses in 11 states and brings more than 14 years of electrical engineering experience, including solar design. It serves residential customers across Madison, Milwaukee, and all of southern Wisconsin.

The company provides turnkey photovoltaic design and installation for homes, handling permitting, shading analysis, and interconnection. Services include roof- and ground-mounted arrays, drone-based 3D site mapping, system monitoring, electric-vehicle charger installation, battery storage, and backup generator (natural gas or propane) installation. It also offers repair and troubleshooting for existing solar arrays. The firm uses components from vetted manufacturers and performs all electrical work to code.

PEC Solar works exclusively with residential homeowners. Its projects range from single-family rooftop systems to ground-mounted arrays on rural properties throughout southern Wisconsin.

The company emphasizes its engineering credentials: it is the only NABCEP-certified PV Design Specialist in Wisconsin, a REC Certified Solar Professional, and holds a master electrician license. It promotes a no-pressure sales approach, promising to advise against solar if it won’t save the customer money.
